method: archived 640 predictions at conf >0.5; original GT; max drone IoU is geometry, not a semantic class
visual_review_scope: All 75 FP crops and 80 no-drone-annotation frames visually inspected at contact-sheet scale; 21 selected positive frames and frame 107 at full resolution. Sample is purposive, one reviewer, not adjudicated.

manual_findings.finding: Two aerial drone-like predicted objects do not overlap the tiny drone GT at the bottom edge. Suspect incomplete annotation and/or erroneous edge label; object identities need source verification.
One predicted drone-like object overlaps its GT at IoU 0.493, counted as FP+FN; a further small predicted object does not overlap a GT and needs review.
15 annotated drone objects; 5 predictions partially overlap GT, but none reaches IoU 0.5. A high FN concentration in one scene.
A detection encloses visible drone content inside a noticeably larger GT box; IoU 0.300 produces both FP and FN. Cannot decide intended box tightness without labeling policy.
Crowded source frame contains nine GT; seven FN and two TP. Some GT boxes overlap and object identity/type is unclear from this still; inspect source and policy before corrections.

Source negative labelled bird shows a held winged device and text THIS MAY LOOK LIKE A BIRD; possible artificial bird/ornithopter, class and drone inclusion need source/policy verification. No 640, 960, or SAHI prediction at threshold 0.5.
Tiny GT overlaps text area; visually ambiguous, not corrected.

limitations: No verification of all negative frames at native resolution; object identity, annotations and exhaustiveness are not guaranteed. Manual observations are hypotheses, not relabeling.
